replies.author: Princezz_Dubstep
replies.body:
Try different levels of your FOV (Face Of View) in your settings.
 
 Go into a creative world and spawn Mobs, get your bow, and do your best to try and shoot them with your bow.
 Then once you improved, you can practice trickshooting. (It's fun ^-^) Like, "360 no scopes", "Jump shots", "180's", "570's" (If your sensitivity is loose :p), "The Double tap Y" (in this case double click right button, for MC.) 
 
 Anyways, I hope this helps yew ^-^ Good Luck!:D
